Item.Value: • Downgraded

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutDowngradedTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Open deals that regressed to an earlier forecast category. Example: Commit → Best Case.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutIdleLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Idle

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutIdleTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Open deals that stayed in the same forecast category from start to end of the period.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutLostLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Lost

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutLostTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Deals marked Closed Lost during the period.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutSlippedLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Slipped

Item.Value: Open deals whose Close Date moved out of the current period into a future one. Example: Q3 → Q4.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutUpgradedLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Upgraded

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutUpgradedTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Open deals that progressed to a later forecast category. Example: Pipeline → Best Case.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutWonLabel_caption.Value

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutWonTextLabel_caption.Value

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOutcomeHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: Outcome categories (right side)

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOverview1_caption.Value
Item.Value: The Sankey chart shows how your open pipeline moved between two points in time.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOverview2_caption.Value
Item.Value: It displays each opportunity as a proportional flow from its starting forecast category (on the left) to its end-of-period outcome (on the right), so the largest movements stand out at a glance.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOverview3_caption.Value
Item.Value: If you also use the Waterfall chart, the two are complementary: Waterfall answers how much your pipeline changed, while Sankey answers what moved, and from where to where. Both read from the same historical data and use the same period model.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpReadHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: How to read the chart

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpReadLeft_caption.Value
Item.Value: Left side — where each deal stood at the start of the change period.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpReadRight_caption.Value
Item.Value: Right side — where it ended up by the end of the change period.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpReadWidth_caption.Value
Item.Value: Width of every node and flow is proportional to the opportunity amount: the left side uses the amount at the start, the right side uses the amount at the end, so a flow that widens or narrows reflects a change in amount.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSourceHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: Source categories (left side)

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSourceIntro_caption.Value
Item.Value: Open deals are grouped by the Forecast Category they held at the start of the period; deals that entered the period during the window go into a dedicated entry category. Pipeline, Best Case, and Commit are Forecast Category values on the opportunity.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcBestCaseLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Best Case

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcBestCaseTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Open deals that are fully qualified with an embedded close plan but still have work to do.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcCommitLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Commit

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcCommitTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Open deals going well and expected to close successfully; they slip only in exceptional cases.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcNewLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • New

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcNewTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Deals newly added to the selected period during the change period: created within the window with a Close Date in the period, or reopened within the current period.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcPipelineLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Pipeline

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcPipelineTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Open deals in the early stages that still need development.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcPulledInLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Pulled In

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcPulledInTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Deals whose Close Date moved from a later period into the selected period. Example: forecast for Q4, moved into Q3.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcPushedInLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Pushed In

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpSrcPushedInTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Deals whose Close Date moved from an earlier period into the selected period, often cleanup of overdue deals. Also includes deals reopened from a past period.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpTitle_caption.Value
Item.Value: See how your pipeline moved across forecast categories with the Sankey chart

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpWorkDrilldownLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Drill down to records

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpWorkDrilldownTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: A focused node shows a tooltip with a View data button. Click View data to filter the opportunity grid below the chart to the records related to that node or flow. The grid shows the current details of those opportunities, not the historical values used to build the chart.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpWorkHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: Work with the chart

Item.Value: • Highlight related flows

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpWorkHighlightTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Click any node or flow to focus it and highlight the related flows on the opposite side, so you can see where a category moved.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyPipelineWidget_title.Value
Item.Value: Sales pipeline movement (Sankey)

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SlippedLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Slipped:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SlippedTextLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: Opportunities that were in the selected close date period, but their Close Date moved to a out of this period during the change period. (Eg Viewing June | change window last 7 days: Jun → Jul).

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpColumnsHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: What each column means

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpCountingHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: How opportunities are counted

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpCountingIntro_caption.Value
Item.Value: When an opportunity has more than one movement in the same change period (for example, it was created and its Amount also changed), the chart decides which column it belongs to using this priority order:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpCountingNote_caption.Value
Item.Value: Most opportunities land in a single column this way. The exception is a deal that both entered and left the period within the same window — for example, created as New and then marked Closed Won. It is counted in two columns, its entry column (New) and its exit column (Won), so that the start and end totals reconcile.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpDecreaseHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: Columns that reduce the period's open pipeline:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpIncreaseHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: Columns that increase the period's open pipeline:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpPriorityOrder_caption.Value
Item.Value: 1. Lost, 2. Won, 3. Slipped, 4. New, 5. Pulled In, 6. Pushed In, 7. Amount Increase, 8. Amount Decrease.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpTitle_caption.Value
Item.Value: See what changed your pipeline value with the Waterfall chart

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WonLabel_caption.Value
Item.Value: • Won:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WonTextLabel_caption.Value
